METHOD CARD · MC-0288 v6 · current CC-BY-4.0 10.5281/zenodo.7994

Lipofection of HEK293T at low passage

T. Okafor · forked from MC-0141 (M. Lindqvist) · v6 published 2026-08-19 · 12 forks · 8 reproductions
ORGANISM · LINE
H. sapiens · HEK293T CVCL_0063
CONDITIONS
37 °C · 5% CO₂ · 48 h
EQUIPMENT
BD FACSymphony A3
EXPECTED OUTCOME
41 ± 3% at p < 12
MATERIALSRRIDs where they exist
1Lipofectamine 3000 · Thermo L3000015lot-sensitive
2Opti-MEM I · Gibco 31985062
3Donor plasmid · 2.5 µg, endotoxin < 0.1 EU/µgcritical
4Anti-GFP · RRID:AB_2313770
STEPS · 9timings are wall-clock, not idealised
1
Thaw a vial at or below p8. Do not carry cells past p12 for this protocol.
day −7 · 20 min hands-on
2
Seed 1.2 × 10⁵ cells per well in a 24-well plate, 500 µL complete medium.
day −1 · 30 min
3
Dilute 2.5 µg donor plasmid in 25 µL Opti-MEM. Serum-free at this step only — carrying serum-free through incubation is the most common way to break this.
day 0 · 15 min · critical step
4
Combine with 1.5 µL P3000 and 1.5 µL Lipofectamine 3000, stand 15 min at room temperature.
5
Add dropwise, return to 37 °C / 5% CO₂ for 48 h…
show all 9 steps
KNOWN FAILURE MODES · 3each one is a real run someone recorded
SAMPLE
Passage above 18 — efficiency falls to 4 ± 1%. Cooperative uptake collapses with receptor loss; not recoverable by reagent change.
confirmed by 2 independent reproductions · Q-2291
PROTOCOL
Serum-free medium through incubation — below 5%. Serum-free belongs to step 3 only.
EQUIPMENT
CO₂ drift below 4.5% mimics the passage effect. Log it before blaming the cells.
added by M. Lindqvist in v6
